Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.bootstrap

Class ApplicationLauncher

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.bootstrap.ApplicationLauncher
public final class ApplicationLauncher extends Object
Application entry point for the email audit engine.

Responsibilities

  • Construct the AuditOrchestrator and all of its collaborators.
  • Execute a single end-to-end audit run via AuditOrchestrator.run().
  • Log the resulting AuditOrchestrator.RunSummary in full.
  • Translate startup and execution failures into clear log output and a non-zero process exit code, suitable for CI pipelines.

Exit codes

0Run completed; zero failed and zero errored files.
1Run completed; one or more files failed or errored.
2Orchestrator could not be initialised (configuration, Playwright, or filesystem failure).
3An unexpected exception occurred during AuditOrchestrator.run() itself.

Resource management

AuditOrchestrator is AutoCloseable and owns a Playwright browser process. It is constructed inside a try-with-resources block so the browser is reliably closed whether the run completes, fails, or throws.
